capabilities: Write the active note path and text selection to a JSON pointer file
Provide copy-pasteable CLAUDE.md instructions for Claude Code integration
Display active note and selection state in Claude Code's status bar
Configure pointer file path and selection debounce interval
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it is installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases.
problem: External tools, scripts, and CLI assistants have no way to know which note is currently open in Obsidian, since that is UI state.

relations.evidence: Two pieces of configuration bring the pointer file into Claude's awareness
Writes the active note path and selection to a JSON pointer file for external tool integration (e.g. Claude Code, Gemini CLI etc.)
Install the BRAT plugin if you haven't already

requires.name: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or other external tools

summary: Writes the active note's path and text selection to a JSON pointer file so external CLI tools like Claude Code can read your current context.
